Role Description The Supervisor Application Developer (.NET & AI LLM) is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, responsible for leading the design, development, and maintenance of enterprise applications that support Xceed’s BPO operations.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Day-to-day responsibilities include translating business requirements into scalable architectures, integrating AI-driven features into existing systems, managing application performance and security, and coordinating with infrastructure, operations, and customer service teams. Qualifications Strong analytical skills to design, optimize, and troubleshoot complex application architectures and AI-driven solutions. Customer service mindset to align technical solutions with client requirements and deliver reliable, user-focused applications. 5+ years of hands-on experience with .NET (C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core) and related frameworks, including RESTful APIs and microservices. Proficiency in SQL and relational databases; familiarity with NoSQL and data pipelines is an advantage.
